items.label: 6ft Trellis for Climbing Plants
items.value: This plant trellis is H70.8" x W11.8". You can adjust the desired height based on the growth of the plant, giving vines/tomatoes space to climb upright. Prevents tangling & boosts plant health

items.label: Anti-rust Material
items.value: This garden trellis features a rust-resistant steel core coated with a protective plastic layer—preventing direct sunlight from causing the steel tubes to overheat and scorch vines, while providing support for plant growth and structure

items.label: Easy Assembly
items.value: The trellis for climbing plants outdoor assembles quickly without tools. The obelisks are also easily disassembled for off-season storage. Note: Please install the longest four plastic pipes to the bottom layer in order to get the largest amount of soil inserted depth

items.label: Decorative & Rustproof
items.value: This rust effect plastic coated iron garden obelisk trellis when placed will make a feature in your garden, patio, or even outdoor in the open, with this piece of drama. Add some climbers such as , climbing vine plants, rose bushes, potted plants indoor, clematis, or Flame Flower for an amazing display

items.label: About us
items.value: Provides quality products and efficient after-sales service. If you're not satisfied with our products,please contact us, we will provide you with a solution as soon as possible
